question: What are the income tax slabs under the new tax regime for AY 2024-25?
What is the basic exemption limit under the old tax regime for a senior citizen?
notes: Senior citizens (60-80 yrs): ₹3,00,000 exemption under old regime

question: Is there a surcharge on income above 50 lakhs?
notes: 10% surcharge on income 50L-1Cr, 15% on 1Cr-2Cr, 25% on 2Cr-5Cr, 37% above 5Cr (capped at 25% under new regime)

question: What is the rebate under section 87A for AY 2024-25?
notes: Rebate u/s 87A: up to ₹25,000 for income up to ₹7L under new regime; ₹12,500 for income up to ₹5L under old regime

question: What is the tax rate for super senior citizens above 80 years?
notes: Super senior (>80 yrs): nil up to ₹5L under old regime

question: What is the maximum deduction allowed under Section 80C?
notes: ₹1,50,000 aggregate limit under 80C

question: What investments qualify for Section 80C deduction?
notes: ELSS, PPF, EPF, NSC, LIC premium, home loan principal, 5yr FD, SCSS, Sukanya Samriddhi

question: What is the deduction limit under Section 80D for health insurance?
notes: ₹25,000 self+family; ₹50,000 if parents are senior citizens; ₹5,000 for preventive health check-up within limit

question: Can I claim deduction on education loan interest under Section 80E?
notes: 80E: full interest deduction on education loan for 8 years or until interest paid, whichever earlier

question: What is the standard deduction for salaried employees?
notes: ₹50,000 standard deduction for salaried employees and pensioners

question: What is the deduction under Section 80TTA for savings account interest?
notes: ₹10,000 deduction on savings account interest for non-senior citizens

question: Can I claim HRA exemption if I live in a rented house and also have a home loan?
notes: Ambiguous: depends on whether properties are in different cities. Bot should ask clarifying question.

question: What is the deduction under Section 80GG for rent paid without HRA?
notes: 80GG: least of ₹5,000/month, 25% of adjusted total income, or actual rent minus 10% of ATI

question: What is the maximum deduction for donations under Section 80G?
notes: 100% or 50% deduction depending on the fund/institution; some with and some without 10% ATI limit

question: Is Section 80C deduction available under the new tax regime?
notes: Most deductions including 80C are NOT available under the new tax regime (Section 115BAC)

question: Which ITR form should a salaried employee with no other income file?
notes: ITR-1 (SAHAJ) for residents with salary, one house property, other sources up to ₹50L total income

question: Which ITR form is used for income from capital gains?
notes: ITR-2 for individuals/HUFs with capital gains (and no business income)

question: Which ITR form should a freelancer with business income use?
notes: Ambiguous: ITR-3 for actual books, ITR-4 (SUGAM) if opting for presumptive taxation u/s 44ADA. Bot should ask.

question: What is the due date for filing ITR for salaried individuals?
notes: July 31 of the assessment year for non-audit cases

question: What is the penalty for filing ITR after the due date?
notes: Section 234F: ₹5,000 if filed after due date but before 31 Dec; ₹1,000 if income below ₹5L

question: What is the tax rate on long-term capital gains from listed equity shares?
notes: 10% LTCG on listed equity/equity MF gains exceeding ₹1L (Section 112A, no indexation)

question: What is the holding period for long-term capital gains on property?
notes: Immovable property: 24 months holding for LTCG classification

question: What is the STCG tax rate on equity mutual funds sold within one year?
notes: Section 111A: 15% STCG on equity MF/shares held less than 12 months

question: Can I save capital gains tax on property sale by investing in another property under Section 54?
notes: Section 54: exemption on LTCG from residential house if proceeds invested in another house (1yr before / 2yr after sale); construction 3 years

question: What is the exemption available under Section 54EC for capital gains?
notes: Section 54EC: invest up to ₹50L in NHAI/REC bonds within 6 months of asset transfer

question: How is indexation benefit applied to calculate long-term capital gains on property?
notes: LTCG = Sale price - Indexed cost; Indexed cost = Actual cost × (CII of sale year / CII of purchase year)

question: What is the TDS rate under Section 194C for payments to individual contractors?
notes: 1% for individuals/HUFs, 2% for others; threshold ₹30,000 single payment or ₹1,00,000 aggregate

question: What is the TDS rate on interest from fixed deposits under Section 194A?
notes: 10% TDS u/s 194A; threshold ₹40,000 for banks (₹50,000 for senior citizens)

question: What is the TDS rate on professional fees under Section 194J?
notes: 10% TDS on fees for professional services; 2% for technical services; threshold ₹30,000

question: How can I avoid TDS deduction on bank interest if my income is below the taxable limit?
notes: Form 15G (individuals below 60) / Form 15H (senior citizens) declaration to prevent TDS

question: What is the TDS rate on rent under Section 194I?
notes: 10% for land/building/furniture; 2% for plant & machinery; threshold ₹2,40,000 per annum

question: What is TDS on salary and which section governs it?
notes: Section 192: TDS on salary at average rate based on estimated annual income and applicable slab

question: What is the GST registration threshold for businesses supplying goods?
notes: ₹40L for goods (₹20L for special category states); ₹20L for services (₹10L for special states)

question: Is GST registration mandatory for e-commerce sellers regardless of turnover?
notes: Yes, e-commerce sellers must register regardless of turnover (Section 24, CGST Act)

question: What documents are needed for GST registration?
notes: PAN, Aadhaar, photos, address proof, bank details, constitution proof

question: Can a composition scheme taxpayer issue a tax invoice?
notes: No. Composition dealers must issue bill of supply, not tax invoice; cannot charge GST to customers

question: What is the due date for filing GSTR-1 for monthly filers?
notes: 11th of the following month for monthly filers; quarterly filers by 13th of month following quarter

question: What is GSTR-3B and when is it due?
notes: GSTR-3B: monthly self-assessed summary return; due by 20th of following month

question: What is the annual GST return and when must it be filed?
notes: GSTR-9: annual return due by 31 December of the following financial year

question: What is the late fee for not filing GSTR-3B on time?
notes: ₹50/day (₹25 CGST + ₹25 SGST); ₹20/day for nil return; capped at ₹10,000

question: What is input tax credit and can a composition dealer claim it?
notes: ITC allows set-off of GST paid on purchases against GST liability; composition dealers CANNOT claim ITC

question: Who is required to pay advance tax and what are the installment due dates?
notes: Payable if tax liability > ₹10,000; 4 instalments: 15% by Jun 15, 45% by Sep 15, 75% by Dec 15, 100% by Mar 15

question: What is the interest charged for non-payment of advance tax under Section 234B?
notes: 1% per month simple interest on shortfall from April to date of assessment under Section 234B

question: What is the deduction limit on home loan interest for a self-occupied property?
notes: Section 24(b): ₹2,00,000 deduction on interest for self-occupied property; full interest for let-out property

question: Is rental income from house property taxable and under which head?
notes: Taxable under 'Income from House Property'; 30% standard deduction on NAV + interest deduction u/s 24

question: What is Form 26AS and what information does it contain?
notes: Annual consolidated tax statement showing TDS, TCS, advance tax, self-assessment tax paid, and refunds

question: What is the limit for cash transactions under Section 269ST?
notes: Section 269ST: no person shall receive ₹2L or more in cash in a single day / single transaction

question: What is the tax treatment of EPF withdrawal before 5 years of service?
notes: TDS at 10% if PAN provided; 34.608% if not. Full amount becomes taxable if withdrawn before 5 years

notes: Out of scope: monetary policy is not Indian Income Tax or GST
